_about: Hand-written notes from ../perf-cvars.md and ../cfg-loading.md, used by the cvar site. where: A = autoexec.cfg (preset/menu member), U = user.cfg (read at startup), E = either file, D = needs -devmode. Not benchmarked.

r_TexturesStreamPoolSize.why: The texture preset forces 1536 (High) / 2048 (Very High), too small for the HD texture pack, so textures thrash (pop-in and hitches). Bigger than your VRAM is worse.

r_TexturesStreamingMipBias.why: Negative values (the popular -3) request higher-res mips everywhere: more VRAM and disk IO, so more streaming hitches, not fewer.

sys_MaxFPS.rec: a cap you can hold, e.g. 45/50/72/90 (with r_VSync 0 or a driver cap)
sys_MaxFPS.why: The menu only offers 0/30/60. An uncapped CPU-bound main thread starves the streaming/job threads; a cap smooths frame pacing. Set in user.cfg it is replaced by the menu value.

r_ShadowsCache.why: Warhorse's own comment: the shadow cache spikes every 10 s.

r_ShadowPoolMaxTimeslicedUpdatesPerFrame.rec: low 20, mid 30, keep the preset above

r_ShadersAsyncCompiling.why: system.cfg already sets 3 (precache mode). 2 is a downgrade, 0 stalls.

e_StreamCgfPoolSize.why: Mesh streaming cache. Below 512 means more re-streaming.

sys_streaming_max_finalize_per_frame.why: Caps the per-frame main-thread stream finalize work. Trades pop-in speed for fewer spikes.

e_StreamCgfMaxTasksInProgress.why: More parallel mesh IO; less pop-in on fast drives.

e_StreamInstancesMaxTasks.why: More parallel instance IO; less pop-in on fast drives.

e_AutoPrecacheCgf.why: 2 = only important meshes; players report more pop-in.

e_svoTI_LowSpecMode.why: SVOTI global illumination internal resolution and shader cost. The presets go 6, 4, 4, 2, 1: the biggest single GPU knob.

e_svoTI_ResScaleBase.why: 2 = half-res cone tracing. The popular 0/1 ("pixelation fix") is a large cost increase.

e_ShadowsCastViewDistRatio.why: How far away objects still cast sun shadows.

r_DeferredShadingAreaLights.why: Complex area lights; only off on the Low preset.

r_FogShadows.why: Volumetric fog shadows are pure extra cost.

r_Beams.why: Light beams through fog: extra cost.

e_VolumetricFog.why: Volumetric fog is extra cost; many configs set it to 1.

r_ssdoHalfRes.why: 0 = full-resolution SSDO, which costs a lot more.

r_ParticlesHalfRes.why: Half-resolution particles: fewer fill-rate spikes in fires and smoke.

e_ParticlesMaxScreenFill.why: Limits how much of the screen particles may cover.

r_MotionBlur.why: Small cost. Also a menu option. KCD1 Clarity turns it off itself while DLSS renders below native.

r_SSReflections.why: Screen-space reflections; Very High only, small cost.

r_WaterVolumeCaustics.why: Underwater caustics; Very High only, small cost.

e_ParticlesMotionBlur.why: Particle motion blur; Very High only, small cost.

r_DepthOfField.why: Const in retail. Costs only in dialogue; low priority.

e_MergedMeshesViewDistRatio.why: Grass/bush draw distance (draw calls). Also the menu's vegetation slider, which replaces it whenever applied.

e_MergedMeshesUseSpines.why: Grass touch-bending simulation (off only on Low).

wh_cc_LodRatioRelative.why: NPC LOD distance relative to e_LodRatio. Crowds are KCD's main CPU cost.

wh_cc_LodForItemNoShadowsBase.why: From which character LOD worn items stop casting shadows.

wh_cc_LodForAttachmentNoShadows.why: From which character LOD attachments stop casting shadows.

sys_job_system_max_worker.rec: 0 on CPUs with more than 8 threads
sys_job_system_max_worker.why: 0 = all logical CPUs. The default is 8, so this only changes anything above 8 threads. Read once at startup: has no effect in autoexec.cfg.

r_MultiThreaded.why: Already on, and const: config files can't change it.

r_BatchType.why: Read every frame; changes a per-batch heuristic (2 = auto). No measured effect.

e_ShadowsClouds.why: Cloud shadows; not in any preset group, so a user.cfg value sticks.

r_DrawNearFoV.why: Field of view of first-person items; not in any preset group.

dont: thread pinning fights the Windows scheduler, bad on hybrid P/E-core Intel CPUs
more VRAM and IO, more hitches
cheat-protected AI/character budgets; don't change without measuring
